name: Tanaka Mayuka
source: A famous romance author living in same apartment complex as protagonist. The protagonist was assigned as her personal assistant from his job to help her with any of her needs. She is a little eccentric, straight forward, rude and perverted. Decides to use protagonist as her model/inspiration for next story she is writing. After raping protagonist she continues to have him follow her orders usual being sex related to help with her novel.
